name: q_cheats
card: Arsène Wenger · 2016 · on doping in sport

name: cold_open
text: On the twenty-ninth of September, an independent commission ruled that, for nine seasons, Manchester City used sham sponsorship deals to hide money from their owners. More than nine hundred million pounds. From two thousand and nine, to twenty eighteen. The last nine seasons of Arsène Wenger's time at Arsenal. The years he spent losing players to City, losing ground to City, and warning anyone who would listen. Almost nobody did.

name: the_principle
text: To understand why this hurts Arsenal fans so much, go back to the day he arrived. September nineteen ninety-six. Arsenal unveil their new manager, and a reporter asks if he will be spending big.

name: the_squeeze
text: For ten years, that worked. Three league titles. The Invincibles. Then Arsenal did something responsible. They borrowed to build a new stadium, and they tightened the budget to pay for it. In his own words, years later, this is when everything changed.

name: takeover
text: September two thousand and eight. Abu Dhabi buys Manchester City. Within a year, City come for Arsenal's squad. July two thousand and nine. Emmanuel Adebayor, twenty-five million pounds. Kolo Touré, sixteen million. Two months later, Adebayor scores against Arsenal and sprints the length of the pitch to celebrate in front of the fans who used to sing his name. Wenger is asked about the players he lost. He does not complain.

name: q_former_players
from: I wish always my former players

name: etihad
text: But by twenty eleven, he had stopped being polite about the money. That July, City announced a new deal with Etihad, the airline of their owners' home state. Shirt, stadium name, the whole campus. Reported at around four hundred million pounds over ten years. Wenger was asked about it, and he said exactly what the commission would find, fifteen years later.

name: card_etihad
lines: “If financial fair play is to have a chance,
the sponsorship has to be at the market price.
It cannot be doubled, tripled or quadrupled.”
credit: Arsène Wenger · July 2011 · via The Guardian

name: nasri
text: Read that again. Sponsorship at the market price. That is the heart of the twenty twenty-six verdict. Deals that looked like sponsorship, where the commission says the real money came from somewhere else. And the same summer Wenger said it, City took two more of his players. Gaël Clichy. Then Samir Nasri, a few days after Wenger said this.

name: q_nasri
from: Ideally I want Samir Nasri to stay

name: titles
text: Nine months later, City were champions. Their first league title in forty-four years, with Nasri and Clichy in the squad. They won it again in twenty fourteen, the summer Bacary Sagna left Arsenal for City on a free. And again in twenty eighteen, with a hundred points. Every one of those titles came inside the nine seasons the commission has now ruled on. In those same nine seasons, Arsenal did not win the league once. And by December twenty seventeen, Wenger had a line for the difference between the two clubs.

name: united
text: A month later, Manchester United signed Alexis Sánchez from Arsenal on huge wages. Wenger was asked if it worried him. Listen to which club he chose to praise.

name: united_2
text: He praised one Manchester club for paying its players with its own resources. He did not say that about the other one.

name: leaks
text: In May twenty eighteen, Wenger left Arsenal. Six months later, the German magazine Der Spiegel published leaked emails from inside Manchester City, suggesting that money presented as sponsorship had come from the owner. In February twenty twenty, UEFA banned City from the Champions League for two seasons. Wenger was asked about it.

name: cas
text: Five months later, it was all gone. The Court of Arbitration for Sport overturned the ban. Some of the allegations, it said, were not established, others were time-barred. City paid a fine for not cooperating, and kept playing in Europe. Jürgen Klopp was not impressed.

name: q_klopp
from: I don't think it was a good day

name: q_pep_cheating
from: The people say that we're cheating

name: verdict
text: The people said they were cheating. In February twenty twenty-three, the Premier League brought its own case. A hundred and fifteen charges. And three and a half years later, the commission found City guilty on almost all of them. Sham contracts with commercial partners. Revenues inflated and costs reduced by more than nine hundred million pounds. And, the commission found, concerted efforts to stop and frustrate the investigation itself.

name: fair
text: Now, to be fair, this is not finished. City deny all wrongdoing. They have already lodged an appeal. The punishment has not even been decided, and a final outcome may not come until twenty twenty-seven. But whatever happens to City now, it cannot give anything back to the man who spent those nine seasons on the other side.

name: ending
text: He lost his players. He lost the title races. For years, he was told that talking about money was an excuse for losing. And all along, he kept saying the same thing. He said it in nineteen ninety-six. He said it in twenty eleven. He said it again in twenty twenty.

name: outro
text: Arsène Wenger tried to warn us. Almost nobody listened.
